definitions.explanation: The ratio of a building's total floor area (summed over all stories) to the area of the plot, expressed as a percentage. A zoning limit that effectively controls how tall or dense a building may be.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{容積率|ようせきりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This area has a high floor area ratio.

examples.japanese: {容積率|ようせきりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ほど、⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}てられる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: The larger the floor area ratio, the taller a building you can put up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{容積率|ようせきりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{緩和|かんわ}→緩和：13846_kanwa⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{高層|こうそう}→高層：04145_kousou⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{建|た}った→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: The floor area ratio was relaxed in front of the station, and high-rise condominiums went up one after another.

notes:
A real-estate and zoning term. Together with ⟦{建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ}→建ぺい率：30019_kenpeiritsu⟧ (building coverage ratio), it governs how much can be built on a lot: coverage ratio limits the footprint, floor area ratio limits total floor space.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {容積率|ようせきりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have a high floor area ratio
- {容積率|ようせきりつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{緩和|かんわ}→緩和：13846_kanwa⟧: relaxation of the floor area ratio
- {容積率|ようせきりつ}{二百|にひゃく}⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧: a floor area ratio of 200%

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ}→建ぺい率：30019_kenpeiritsu⟧: building coverage ratio — the footprint limit, not total floor area
